symptoms: 'Tiger stripe' interveinal chlorosis and necrosis on mature leaves
Dark brown/purple speckling on grape berry skins ('measles')
Apoplexy (sudden mid-summer vine collapse and wilting)
risk_factors: Older established vineyards with large pruning wounds exposed to rain
Summer heat and drought stress on infected vines
prevention: Prune late in the dormant season and protect large cuts with wound sealant
Avoid severe water stress through balanced deficit irrigation
recommended_actions: Retrain suckers from trunk base to renew canopy on severely cankered vines
